calibration.scope: Bounded probe search within the remaining call cap; model-safe means hazard-free under every evidence-compatible enabled model, conditional on truthful semantics.

evidence_certificate.scope: Finite public-model evidence only; conditional on target inclusion, stationarity, deterministic reset and truthful anchors; does not authenticate observations, validate private audit/runtime accounting, or establish real-world safety.

calibration_safety.scope: Entire dispatched words checked before their outputs, including interrupted suffixes. Conditional on enabled model inclusion, stationarity, reset semantics and truthful anchors; unrestricted calibration makes no safety claim.

reset_consistency.scope: Equal action prefixes after reset must have equal raw outputs in a stationary deterministic target with reliable resets. A conflict does not identify drift, stochasticity or reset failure as its cause; absence of a conflict does not establish those assumptions.

model_diagnostics.scope: Calibration observations and supplied anchors only. UNKNOWN means not refuted by the observed evidence, including when a task is admitted; it never establishes actual model inclusion. REFUTED means every enabled finite class is inconsistent. Each forecast uses only earlier evidence; outputs after class refutation are unscored. No extra target calls are made.

reliability.scope: Synthetic target-cluster estimates. Intervals, when present, assume independent generator draws and an identical fixed nuisance-cell design; each interval is pointwise, not a simultaneous guarantee. Structural hashes and planned seed selection do not establish independence or real-world probabilities. Exact binomial bounds describe any hazard across the nuisance design; useful-coverage bounds are Hoeffding bounds for equal-target means. Selective harm is the ratio of equal-target failure and admission means; abstention leaves it undefined when no target admits.
